scripts.mix: AUDIO_ONLY=1 remotion render src/video/index.ts Reel out/mix.wav --codec=wav --log=error
scripts.cover: remotion still src/video/index.ts Cover out/cover.png --frame=0 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/cover.png -q:v 2 publish/cover-1080x1920.jpg && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/cover.png -vf crop=1080:1350:0:285 -q:v 2 publish/cover-1080x1350.jpg
